description: Find electric vehicles by brand or model name, or list the whole catalog ranked for a use case, optionally only those with at least a given range. Use it first whenever you have a name but no slug, and for questions like 'which EVs go furthest'; for a published 'best EV for ...' list with its criterion use get_ranking. Returns per model the slug (pass it to get_model or compare_models), score out of 100 (SuliHuli Index 4.4 by default, or the use-case score of another preset), official range with its test cycle and the WLTP-equivalent, DC 10-80 % minutes, battery kWh, which of them are unverified, markets and the page URL. A minimum range is compared on range_basis, and the answer says which. There is no price or market filter: for a budget use get_ownership_cost without slug (ranked with new prices) or search 'cheapest electric cars', and read prices per market with get_model. Paged: total, page, total_pages. detail 'full' adds each figure's source and the cover photo credit.

detail.description: summary (default): the short answer. full: every row as well, with source chains and photo credits.

limit.description: Models per page (default 20, at most 50 without an API key).

locale.description: Language of the answer's text and page links (default en): en.

min_range_km.description: Only EVs whose range is at least this many kilometres, on the basis of range_basis. For miles, multiply by 1.609 and round down: 300 miles = 482 km (the catalog stores 300 miles as 482.8 km, so 483 would drop them).

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1); see total_pages in the answer.

preset.description: What the ranking optimizes for (default index): index (the main score: passport 40 %, people 30 %, market 30 %); everyday (a balanced daily driver — range, charging and practicality); long_range (maximum distance per charge for road trips); family (space, seats and practicality for a family); performance (acceleration and fast-charging capability); city (a short, easy-to-park car that still charges fast); winter (range that survives the cold — ranked on our own winter estimate).

query.description: Words of the brand and/or model name, any order, case-insensitive; every word must match, e.g. 'tesla 3', 'ioniq', 'bmw ix'. Omit to rank the whole catalog.

range_basis.description: What min_range_km is compared with: wltp_equivalent (default; an EPA figure x1.15, CLTC x0.82, NEDC x0.80), official (the published figure on its own cycle), or one cycle - epa, wltp, cltc, nedc - whose own figure must reach it (a model without a figure on that cycle is left out). A US '300 miles' is an EPA figure: range_basis 'epa'.

name: search_models

hint.description: Why a page is empty and what to try.

range_km_on_basis.description: The figure on the named cycle the filter compared.

unverified.description: Which of range, charging_10_80_min, battery_kwh are unverified.

range_basis_note.description: The comparison in words, and how many models it left out.

terms.description: Terms the data is given under.

title: Search and rank EVs
